A building constructed by [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="22 BBY">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]'' depicts the Revwien Comedy Academy Playhouse during the events of {{Film|II}}, which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> the '''Revwien Comedy Academy Playhouse''' was located next to the [[Vos Gesal Hotel/Legends|Vos Gesal Hotel]] in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="CL" /> It was located at the district's outer edge, near the [[Senate District/Legends|Senate District]].<ref name="S&V 57">{{StarshipsVehiclesCite|57|In A Galaxy Far, Far Away}}</ref> The building shared part of its name with the [[Revwien/Legends|Revwiens]],<ref name="CL" /> a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the planet [[Revyia]].<ref name="Galaxy Guide">''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Revwien Comedy Academy was first mentioned in the [[2003]] reference book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]'', which was written by [[Simon Beecroft]] and [[Curtis Saxton]] and illustrated by [[Hans Jenssen]] and [[Richard Chasemore]].<ref name="Inside">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]''</ref>
